gloss: even at this late stage; belatedly

definitions.gloss: even at this late stage; belatedly; I know it's late but
definitions.explanation: Acknowledges that one is realizing, appreciating, or doing something later than expected. Often used when expressing a realization that should have come sooner.

examples.japanese: {今更|いまさら}ながら⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even at this late stage, I have regrets.

examples.japanese: {今更|いまさら}ながら、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Belatedly, I truly felt the importance of health.

examples.japanese: {今更|いまさら}ながら、⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたい→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Even at this late stage, I want to express my gratitude to my parents.

notes:
USAGE:
Used at the beginning of a sentence or clause to preface a belated realization or action. Carries a tone of self-awareness about the lateness. Often used with verbs of realization ({気|き}づく, ⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or emotion (⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧, ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今更|いまさら}→今更：01743_imasara⟧: it's too late now — can be more dismissive or negative
- {今更|いまさら}ながら: acknowledges lateness but still proceeds — more reflective and sincere
